Title: Corrected billing for Azure SQL Data Warehouse and other Azure services

Body.Content:
We’ve corrected billing for Azure SQL Data Warehouse and other Azure services that impacted EA customers only.

On April 10, 2019, we sent an email about a recent system error to some EA customers regarding SQL data warehouse meters to be inadvertently omitted from the bill. We’re following up to clarify that only a small number of SQL Data Warehouse meters were affected. 

Additionally, while investigating the error, we discovered that some meters from Azure Cosmos DB, HDInsight, and Virtual Machines were also affected during the same period (February 1, 2019 through March 31, 2019).
